description: Dot clone works through mutable references, Box containers, and explicit clone methods reached by dereference.
A mutable reference stored inside an immutable Box still grants mutable field and method access.
A loop whose break operands are all never has never type even under an expected type.
Lifetime arguments on a method segment are accepted.
Lifetime arguments on a struct type are accepted.
Ordering comparisons do not automatically dereference Box.
Ordering comparisons require matching reference mutability at every layer.
Compound assignment accepts only a scalar or one shared-reference right operand.
Struct expressions reject type arguments on the struct path.
Value paths reject type arguments on a user struct type segment.
A mutable reference to a non-Clone type cannot be cloned.
The main function cannot have lifetime generic parameters.
